videos.title: The Revolt That Emptied Santa Fe: Who Planned It?
videos.description:
In 1680, Pueblo communities in present-day New Mexico drove Spanish colonists out of Santa Fe. A Pueblo religious leader organized the uprising, and villages timed it using a shared calendar carried by runners. Several causes shaped the revolt, and Spanish rule returned in 1692.
#PuebloRevolt #NewMexicoHistory #NativeAmericanHistory

videos.title: Why Did Japan's Flower Parties Switch Flowers?
